marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure CapEx
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology giants reported sustained year-over-year increases in capital expenditures dedicated to AI data centers and hardware, while short-term monetization metrics showed mixed growth across enterprise SaaS segments.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high CapEx provides ongoing revenue tailwinds for semiconductor and hardware supply chains, but valuations for software platforms may face pressure until generative AI returns accelerate.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential delays in enterprise AI adoption schedules and capacity bottlenecks in power supply and high-bandwidth memory.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Chinese Internet Majors
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index experienced range-bound volatility as Southbound capital recorded net buying in core internet leaders alongside announcements of renewed share buyback programs.
marketLayer.inference: Corporate share repurchases and institutional inflows via Stock Connect offer a valuation floor for major HK-listed platforms, even as top-line revenue growth moderates.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Shift in domestic consumer spending momentum and potential changes in regional platform competition dynamics.

marketLayer.title: New Energy Vehicles (EV) & Auto Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV manufacturers reported accelerated overseas delivery figures for the current month while domestic price adjustments stabilized across mainstream passenger segments.
marketLayer.inference: Export market expansion is increasingly serving as a primary driver for margin improvement, compensating for tight domestic margin competition in price-sensitive tiers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policy tariffs and localization mandates in European and North American import markets.

marketLayer.title: Macro Liquidity & Federal Reserve Rate Path
marketLayer.fact: US Treasury yields flattened slightly following economic data indications of cooling labor market conditions and steady core inflation prints.
marketLayer.inference: Expectations for upcoming rate cuts remain intact, easing discount-rate pressure on high-growth equities and stabilizing yield differentials for emerging market assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected commodity price shocks or persistent services inflation that could defer anticipated monetary easing schedules.
